# fct_surveys_pulse

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_surveys_pulse` · dbt area: `surveys`

Responses from the recurring Advisor Pulse Survey (formerly known as the NPS survey). Includes likelihood to recommend, likelihood to stay, CSAT, confidence in growth, and qualitative responses. Each row is one response from an advisor. Sourced from a mix of Intercom and Typeform data, as Intercom was the system starting only in 2025-10.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `response_id` | Primary key. The survey's response ID. >> SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform |
| `advisor_id` | The 'User ID' in the Portal database  >>  SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform |
| `advisor_uuid` | UUID version of the Advisor ID.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `certification_at_response` | This is estimated. Name of the Certification level of the Advisor at the time of their response, such as 'Pro' or 'Certified'. We do not actually track the date Advisors moved certifications, so we estimate it from history tables (and prior to Fall 2024, from historic booking milestones). >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `confidence_in_growing_business_rating` | Advisor's 'confidence in whether their business will grow in the next 3 months' on a scale of 1-5 (1 = Not Confident and 5 = Very Confident). >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `csat_rating` | Advisor's 'level of satistfaction with Fora' on a scale of 1-5 (1 = Not Satisifed, 5 = Very Satisfied). >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `days_signed_up_to_responded` | Calendar days from the Advisor's 'Signed Up Date' to their response's 'Submitted At Date'. >> SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform |
| `email` | The Advisor's email, typically their fora.travel address. >> SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform |
| `likelihood_to_recommend_rating` | Advisor's response to 'how likely they would recommend Fora on a scale of 0-10'. >> SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform |
| `likelihood_to_stay_rating` | Advisors's answer to 'how likely they are to still be at Fora in one year' (1 = Not Likely, 5 = Very Likely). >> SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform |
| `qualitative_responses` | Advisor's answers to open-ended questions. >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `supported_by_fora_rating` | Advisor's response to how supported they feel by Fora and resources provided on a scale of 1-5 (1 = Not Supported, 5 = Very Supported). >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `submitted_at` | Timestamp when the survey was submitted. >> SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform |
| `survey_source` | The response's source (Intercom or Typeform). >> SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform. |
| `survey_title` | The title of the specific survey, where NPS776 = Pro+X, NPS639 = New Joiners, NPS255 = General Audience, Intercom = Intercom. >> SOURCE - Intercom / Typeform |
